summary: postinstall installs undeclared sibling package randompkgb
details: package.json declares a postinstall script `npm i randompkgb` that fetches and installs an undeclared sibling npm package on the installer's machine at install time. Because randompkgb is not listed in dependencies or devDependencies, it does not appear in lockfiles or dependency audits of randompkga, yet its own lifecycle scripts and module code execute in the installer's environment on `npm install`. The package author can swap the executed payload at any time by publishing a new version of randompkgb without changing randompkga.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
